_comment: Platform specs for the SocialMediaExport ComfyUI node. Keys beginning with '_' are metadata/comments and are ignored by the loader (they are not selectable platforms). Each platform is an aspect-ratio BAND (ar_min..ar_max), a pixel envelope (max_w x max_h), an optional upscale floor (min_w), an output format, and an optional byte cap (max_bytes). See README.md for the meaning of every field and the verification status of every number. Edit this file freely; it is re-read on every node execution (no restart needed).

_schema.ar_min: float, smallest allowed width/height ratio (tallest image) before cropping
_schema.ar_max: float, largest allowed width/height ratio (widest image) before cropping
_schema.max_w: int, maximum output width in pixels (envelope)
_schema.max_h: int, maximum output height in pixels (envelope)
_schema.min_w: int, optional; upscale floor, only used when allow_upscale=True
_schema.max_bytes: int, optional; encoder steps quality down (floor 70) to fit under this
_schema._source: official documentation URL, or 'UNVERIFIED' when core geometry is a best estimate
_schema._note: optional; design decisions and which specific fields are best estimates

instagram_feed._note: VERIFIED: AR 4:5 (0.8) to 1.91:1, 8 MB max, min width 320 / max width 1440 (API scales up to 1440), sRGB. min_w=1080 is a quality floor (official minimum is 320); max_h=1800 = 4:5 at 1440 wide.

instagram_story._note: VERIFIED: full-screen story/reel is 9:16 (0.5625) at 1080x1920. The band is intentionally a single point (ar_min==ar_max) because a story is a fixed full-screen format: anything not 9:16 is minimally cropped (or padded) to 9:16. max_bytes reuses Instagram's 8 MB image limit.

x_timeline._note: VERIFIED: single photos with aspect ratios between 3:4 (0.75) and 2:1 (2.0) display in full; formats JPG/PNG/GIF. ESTIMATED: max_w/max_h (2048) and max_bytes (5 MB) — X's developer media-spec pages were not machine-accessible (HTTP 402/403) at verification time; 5 MB still-image cap and ~2048 px display width are the widely-reported values.

tiktok_photo._note: VERIFIED: Content Posting API photo aspect ratio must be between 1/2.2 (0.4545) and 2.2. ESTIMATED: max_w/max_h (1080x1920, TikTok's portrait-first canvas) — the photo file-size/resolution restrictions doc was not accessible. No max_bytes set (unknown), so no byte cap is enforced.

tiktok_vertical._note: DESIGN: full-screen vertical 9:16 (0.5625) at 1080x1920 — the TikTok feed canvas. Unlike 'tiktok_photo' (which keeps whatever ratio TikTok accepts, 0.4545..2.2, so a square stays square), this variant forces the full-screen portrait shape, the way instagram_story/facebook_story do. Use it when you want the image to fill the TikTok feed with no letterboxing added by TikTok. Single-point band (ar_min==ar_max). Same estimated pixel envelope as tiktok_photo; no max_bytes (TikTok's photo size limit is undocumented).

pinterest_pin._note: VERIFIED: recommended 2:3 (0.6667) at 1000x1500; pins taller than 2:4.2 (0.476) are truncated in feed; formats include JPEG/PNG; 20 MB web upload limit. DESIGN: band spans the truncation floor (0.476) up to the recommended 2:3 (0.6667), so wider masters crop toward the native portrait pin.

facebook_feed._note: VERIFIED: supported feed image AR 1.91:1 to 4:5 (0.8) with 3% tolerance; recommended 1440x1800 (4:5); 30 MB max file size; JPG/PNG. min_w=1080 is a quality floor (official minimum width is 600).

facebook_story._note: VERIFIED: Facebook Stories placement is 9:16 (0.5625) at 1080x1920; 30 MB max file size. Single-point band for the same reason as instagram_story.

threads_feed._note: VERIFIED: Threads image posts accept AR between 0.01:1 and 10:1 (9:16 recommended to avoid cropping/blank space), JPEG/PNG, 8 MB max, sRGB. The very wide band means Threads almost never needs cropping — the node just scales. ESTIMATED: max_w/max_h (1080x1920) — Threads publishes no pixel-dimension limits, only the 8 MB + AR + sRGB constraints.

bluesky._note: VERIFIED: individual images are hard-capped at 1,000,000 bytes (decimal, not 2^20); metadata should be stripped (this node does). ESTIMATED: AR band (0.5..2.0) and max_w/max_h (2000) — the AT Protocol imposes no aspect-ratio or dimension limit and the app's in-feed crop threshold is undocumented. The 1 MB cap makes the encoder's quality-stepping loop the important behavior here.

reddit._note: UNVERIFIED: Reddit publishes no accessible image-post spec (reddit.com is blocked to crawlers; support.reddithelp.com documents only avatars/banners/community assets). All numbers here are best estimates for a feed-friendly image post. No max_bytes enforced.
